name: Add Labels
description: Adds labels to a lead, person, deal, or organization in Pipedrive. [See the documentation](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Leads#updateLead)

configurable_props.name: type
configurable_props.label: Type
configurable_props.description: The type of the item to add labels to

configurable_props.name: leadId
configurable_props.label: Lead ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the lead to add labels to

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the person to add labels to

configurable_props.name: dealId
configurable_props.label: Deal ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the deal to add labels to

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the organization to add labels to

configurable_props.name: leadLabelIds
configurable_props.label: Lead Label IDs
configurable_props.description: The IDs of the lead labels to associate with the lead

configurable_props.name: personLabelIds
configurable_props.label: Person Label IDs
configurable_props.description: The IDs of the person labels to associate with the person

configurable_props.name: dealLabelIds
configurable_props.label: Label IDs
configurable_props.description: The IDs of labels assigned to the deal

configurable_props.name: organizationLabelIds
configurable_props.label: Organization Label IDs
configurable_props.description: The IDs of the organization labels to associate with the organization

configurable_props.name: replaceExistingLabels
configurable_props.label: Replace Existing Labels
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` to replace the existing labels with the new ones, `false` to add the new labels to the existing ones. Defaults to `false`.
